notes: 40 Hitpoints, Defence 40, max hit 6, 4-tick; attacks with stab melee and magic.

Location: the wiki cites the Stronghold of Security (Pit of Pestilence area); the CT-L ownership map lists the 2nd level. The exact sub-level is left for QA to live-verify; the family uses a tuned copy stronghold-of-security-catablepon rather than the Ankou-specific base file.
Three combat-level variants share one monster (NPC ids 2474/2475/2476) with Slayer XP 40/70/50; the default variant pins the level-68 form.

recommendedMethod: Catablepon have high stab and range defensive bonuses, so attack with a crush weapon which meets their lowest bonus (crush +20). They hit up to 6 with stab melee and magic, so bring food for the low-level Stronghold of Security dungeon. No elemental weakness applies. Any of the three combat-level forms counts toward the task.
